tasks.title: Setup NGINX Reverse Proxy for Go App
success_criteria: Docker Compose successfully starts both `nginx` and `go-app` services.
NGINX proxies requests on port 80 to the Go app on port 8080.
The `X-Request-ID` header is added by NGINX and received by the Go app.
Gzip compression is enabled and verifiable via `curl`.

tasks.title: Create a Reusable Terraform Module for an S3 Bucket
success_criteria: Terraform module structure is correctly created in `modules/s3_bucket`.
Module variables for bucket name prefix, versioning, ACL, and tags are defined.
Module outputs the S3 bucket ARN and ID.
Example `main.tf` in `example/` directory correctly uses the module.
`terraform init` and `terraform validate` succeed for the example.
`terraform plan` for the example runs successfully and shows the intended resources.
Solution script provides clear steps to test the module.
